checks.text: Typing `{"name":"Alice"` in the editor labelled "Input JSON" and clicking the button "Format" shows the message "Invalid JSON: Unexpected end of JSON input" and the editor labelled "Output JSON" is empty.
Typing `{"name":"Alice","age":30}` in the editor labelled "Input JSON" and clicking the button "Copy Output" shows the toast "Copied to clipboard".

Typing `{"name":"Alice","age":30}` in the editor labelled "Input JSON", clicking the button "Validate", and then typing `{"name":"Bob","age":25}` in the editor labelled "Input JSON" and clicking the button "Validate" shows the message "Validation passed".

Typing `{"name":"Alice","age":30}` in the editor labelled "Input JSON", clicking the button "Validate", and then typing `{"name":"Alice","age":"thirty"}` in the editor labelled "Input JSON" and clicking the button "Validate" shows the message "age must be a number".
Clicking the tab labelled "History" shows a list of previously formatted JSON snippets; the first item contains the text `{"name":"Alice","age":30}`.
Clicking the button "Clear History" on the History tab removes all items from the list and shows the text "No history yet".
Reload keeps the text `{"name":"Alice","age":30}` in the editor labelled "Input JSON" and the formatted output in the editor labelled "Output JSON".
